edges.effect_quant: Dose-response meta-analyses backed by prospective cohorts point in more than one direction, so no single pooled effect estimate is reliable enough to summarize cleanly.
edges.population: adults taking levothyroxine with interfering supplements
edges.mechanism: Levothyroxine absorption is easily reduced by concurrent calcium, iron, and other binding agents in the gut, so dosing timing strongly changes bioavailability. That mechanism directly links supplement overlap to poorer Thyroid control.
edges.summary: In adults taking levothyroxine with interfering supplements, dose-response meta-analyses backed by prospective cohorts suggest that levothyroxine tracks with mixed effects on thyroid control. This is one of the cleaner pharmacology edges in the set because the adverse pathway is predictable and monitoring can often reduce harm.
edges.caveats: Medication benefits may still outweigh this risk. The practical implication is usually monitoring, dosing separation, or targeted supplementation rather than indiscriminate discontinuation.
